review.summary: Re-solved all 25; en/id parity and breakdowns are otherwise clean. Verified by hand: Q3 (n must be odd → 95 impossible), Q13 (A=8 beats E=7), Q17 (108), Q19 (opposite-product 56), Q21 (T(10)=55, T(11)=66 → 21), Q22 (7's partner 2 or 5 → 10). One real steps/clarity issue (Q20) plus an interpretation note (Q5); the rest figure-dependent and internally consistent.

findings.note: Answer 6 is correct ONLY under a non-negative-result reading (verified min ≥0 is 58−53+1=6). But the stem never forbids negatives — if allowed, the true minimum is −67 (e.g. 13−85+5). And the English hint_steps are muddled/self-contradictory: they advise 'make the two 2-digit numbers as close as possible (51, 53)' (which yields 53−51+8=10), then write the negative intermediate '51−53+8=6'. Fix: tighten the stem to 'smallest non-negative result' and rewrite the steps around 58−53+1=6.

Interpretation-sensitive: keyed 238 follows 'skip-count in 7s starting at 101' (107, 114, 121, …, i.e. 100+7k). Under a plain 'multiples of 7' reading, 238=34×7 would be counted and the odd-one-out would be 212 instead. The hint commits to the intended reading; consider wording the stem to make the start-at-101 grouping explicit.
Hamiltonian rabbit-maze: move string 1 1 4 3 3 4 4 4 1 2 1 4 sums to 32 and is self-consistent, but route uniqueness depends on the reconstructed grid/stones (not re-derived against the scan).
5×5 quad-clue Sudoku — uniqueness not proven by a backtracking solver this pass. The given solution (24135/13524/35241/41352/52413) is a valid Latin square and column 5 reads 54123.

hint_steps_en: Left to right: 94 − 67 = 27, then 27 + 21 = 48.
48 matches 6 × 8.

Sekarang periksa hasil kalinya: 8×9 = 72, 6×8 = 48, 7×7 = 49, 9×5 = 45.
48 cocok dengan 6 × 8.

highlights.note_id: Hitung ruas kiri dulu, lalu cocokkan dengan hasil kali.

questions.body_en: Look at the options below. Which has the longest black line?
questions.body_id: Perhatikan pilihan di bawah. Garis hitam mana yang paling panjang?
hint_steps_en: Count unit steps along each line — don't judge by eye.
C: 7 across + 8 up-down = 15 — the longest.
hint_steps_id: Hitung langkah satuan di tiap garis — jangan menilai dengan mata.
A: 8 mendatar + 6 naik-turun = 14. B: 8 + 5 = 13. D: 10 + 3 = 13.
C: 7 mendatar + 8 naik-turun = 15 — yang terpanjang.

highlights.note_en: Length = number of unit segments; count them, square by square.
highlights.note_id: Panjang = banyak ruas satuan; hitung petak demi petak.

strategy.name_en: Count unit segments instead of trusting your eyes
strategy.name_id: Hitung ruas satuan, jangan percaya mata

trap.why_en: D's long flat strokes look impressive but total only 13 units.
trap.why_id: Goresan datar panjang di D tampak hebat tapi totalnya hanya 13 satuan.

questions.body_en: Students stand to form a cross. The numbers of students in the row and in the column are the same, and John is in the center of both. Which option below cannot be the total number of students?
questions.body_id: Para siswa berdiri membentuk tanda silang. Banyak siswa di baris dan di kolom sama, dan John berada di tengah keduanya. Pilihan mana yang tidak mungkin menjadi total banyak siswa?
hint_steps_en: A cross with n in the row and n in the column shares John once: total = 2n − 1.
So n = (total + 1) ÷ 2. And John is in the CENTER of a line of n, so n must be ODD.
25 → n = 13 ✓ odd. 61 → n = 31 ✓. 49 → n = 25 ✓. But 95 → n = 48, an even number — John couldn't be in its exact center.
hint_steps_id: Silang dengan n di baris dan n di kolom memakai John sekali: total = 2n − 1.
Jadi n = (total + 1) ÷ 2. Dan John di TENGAH barisan n orang, jadi n harus GANJIL.
25 → n = 13 ✓ ganjil. 61 → n = 31 ✓. 49 → n = 25 ✓. Tapi 95 → n = 48, genap — John tak bisa tepat di tengahnya.

highlights.phrase_en: John is in the center of both
highlights.note_en: A line with an exact center must have an ODD count.
highlights.note_id: Barisan dengan tengah yang pasti harus berjumlah GANJIL.

highlights.note_en: Total = row + column − John = 2n − 1.
highlights.note_id: Total = baris + kolom − John = 2n − 1.

strategy.name_en: Work backwards from the total to n, then test oddness
strategy.name_id: Mundur dari total ke n, lalu uji ganjilnya

trap.why_en: All four totals are odd, so odd totals alone don't decide — it's n = (total+1)÷2 that must be odd.
trap.why_id: Keempat total ganjil, jadi keganjilan total saja tak memutuskan — yang harus ganjil adalah n = (total+1)÷2.

questions.body_en: Penny notices on this month’s calendar that the numbers of Saturdays and Sundays are both 5. However, each weekday from Monday to Friday appears only 4 times. How many days are there this month?
questions.body_id: Penny melihat kalender bulan ini: banyak hari Sabtu dan Minggu masing-masing 5. Namun setiap hari Senin sampai Jumat hanya muncul 4 kali. Berapa hari dalam bulan ini?
hint_steps_en: Add up the day counts: 2 days appear 5 times and 5 days appear 4 times.
Check: a 30-day month starting on Saturday has Saturdays on 1, 8, 15, 22, 29 and Sundays on 2, 9, 16, 23, 30 — five each ✓.
hint_steps_id: Jumlahkan banyak harinya: 2 hari muncul 5 kali dan 5 hari muncul 4 kali.
Cek: bulan 30 hari yang dimulai Sabtu punya Sabtu pada 1, 8, 15, 22, 29 dan Minggu pada 2, 9, 16, 23, 30 — masing-masing lima ✓.

highlights.note_en: Two day-names occur 5 times: 2 × 5 = 10 days.
highlights.note_id: Dua nama hari muncul 5 kali: 2 × 5 = 10 hari.

highlights.phrase_en: Monday to Friday appears only 4 times
highlights.phrase_id: Senin sampai Jumat hanya muncul 4 kali
highlights.note_en: Five day-names occur 4 times: 5 × 4 = 20 days.
highlights.note_id: Lima nama hari muncul 4 kali: 5 × 4 = 20 hari.

strategy.name_en: The month's length is just the sum of all day-name counts
strategy.name_id: Panjang bulan adalah jumlah semua kemunculan nama hari

trap.why_en: 31 days would force THREE day-names to appear 5 times, not two.
trap.why_id: 31 hari memaksa TIGA nama hari muncul 5 kali, bukan dua.

questions.body_en: Count from 101 to 300. Which number below will not be counted when the numbers are counted by 5’s and by 7’s?
questions.body_id: Hitung dari 101 sampai 300. Bilangan mana di bawah ini yang tidak akan terhitung saat menghitung loncat 5 maupun loncat 7?
hint_steps_en: Counting by 5's starting at 101 lands on 105, 110, 115, … — the multiples of 5.
Counting by 7's starting at 101 lands on 107, 114, 121, … — numbers that are 100 + a multiple of 7.
175 and 255 are multiples of 5 ✓ counted. 212 = 100 + 112 = 100 + 7×16 ✓ counted.
238: not a multiple of 5, and 238 − 100 = 138 is not a multiple of 7 — never counted.
hint_steps_id: Menghitung loncat 5 dari 101 mendarat di 105, 110, 115, … — kelipatan 5.
Menghitung loncat 7 dari 101 mendarat di 107, 114, 121, … — bilangan 100 + kelipatan 7.
175 dan 255 kelipatan 5 ✓ terhitung. 212 = 100 + 112 = 100 + 7×16 ✓ terhitung.
238: bukan kelipatan 5, dan 238 − 100 = 138 bukan kelipatan 7 — tak pernah terhitung.

highlights.note_en: The skip-counts start AT 101, so the landing spots shift: 105, 110, … and 107, 114, …
highlights.note_id: Hitung loncat dimulai DARI 101, jadi pendaratannya bergeser: 105, 110, … dan 107, 114, …

highlights.note_en: Must miss BOTH lists.
highlights.note_id: Harus luput dari KEDUA daftar.

strategy.name_en: Find where each skip-count lands, then test each option
strategy.name_id: Temukan tempat mendarat tiap hitung loncat, lalu uji tiap pilihan

trap.why_en: 212 isn't a multiple of 5 or 7, but counting by 7's from 101 DOES hit it: 101 + 7×16 lands near it — check 100 + 112 = 212.
trap.why_id: 212 bukan kelipatan 5 atau 7, tapi menghitung loncat 7 dari 101 MENGENAINYA: 100 + 112 = 212.

questions.body_en: Stephen has two alarm clocks. The red clock is 15 minutes fast, and the blue clock is 20 minutes slow. When Stephen wakes up, the blue clock shows 06:05. What time does the red clock show?
questions.body_id: Stephen punya dua jam weker. Jam merah lebih cepat 15 menit, dan jam biru lebih lambat 20 menit. Saat Stephen bangun, jam biru menunjukkan 06.05. Pukul berapa yang ditunjukkan jam merah?
hint_steps_en: The blue clock runs 20 minutes behind, so the true time is 06:05 + 20 = 06:25.
The red clock runs 15 minutes ahead of the true time.
hint_steps_id: Jam biru terlambat 20 menit, jadi waktu sebenarnya 06.05 + 20 = 06.25.
Jam merah lebih cepat 15 menit dari waktu sebenarnya.

highlights.note_en: Slow clock shows LESS — add 20 to get the true time.
highlights.note_id: Jam lambat menunjukkan KURANG — tambah 20 untuk waktu sebenarnya.

highlights.note_en: Fast clock shows MORE — add 15 to the true time.
highlights.note_id: Jam cepat menunjukkan LEBIH — tambah 15 ke waktu sebenarnya.

strategy.name_en: Go through the true time as the bridge between the clocks
strategy.name_id: Lewati waktu sebenarnya sebagai jembatan antara kedua jam

trap.why_en: Subtracting both errors (06:05 − 20 − 15) walks the wrong way on both clocks.
trap.why_id: Mengurangi kedua selisih (06.05 − 20 − 15) berjalan ke arah salah pada kedua jam.

questions.body_id: Jika □ × □ × □ = 64, berapa □ × 5?
hint_steps_en: Find a number that multiplied by itself three times gives 64.
hint_steps_id: Cari bilangan yang dikalikan dirinya tiga kali memberi 64.
Coba: 3×3×3 = 27 (terlalu kecil), 4×4×4 = 64 ✓.
Jadi □ = 4 dan □ × 5 = 20.

highlights.note_en: The same number three times — try small numbers.
highlights.note_id: Bilangan yang sama tiga kali — coba bilangan kecil.

strategy.name_en: Try small candidates for the repeated factor
strategy.name_id: Coba kandidat kecil untuk faktor yang berulang

trap.why_en: □ = 8 works for 8×8 = 64 but the puzzle multiplies THREE boxes, not two.
trap.why_id: □ = 8 cocok untuk 8×8 = 64 tapi soal mengalikan TIGA kotak, bukan dua.

questions.body_en: A group of people line up to buy train tickets, and Bob stands in the middle of the line. 15 minutes later, 8 people have bought their tickets, and it will be Bob’s turn after 6 more people finish. How many people line up to buy train tickets?
questions.body_id: Sekelompok orang antre membeli tiket kereta, dan Bob berdiri tepat di tengah barisan. 15 menit kemudian, 8 orang sudah membeli tiket, dan giliran Bob tiba setelah 6 orang lagi selesai. Berapa orang yang antre membeli tiket?
hint_steps_en: In front of Bob stand 8 + 6 = 14 people, so Bob is the 15th.
Bob is the exact middle: 14 in front means 14 behind.
hint_steps_id: Di depan Bob ada 8 + 6 = 14 orang, jadi Bob orang ke-15.
Bob tepat di tengah: 14 di depan berarti 14 di belakang.

highlights.note_en: Middle = equal numbers in front and behind.
highlights.note_id: Tengah = sama banyak di depan dan di belakang.

highlights.phrase_en: 8 people have bought their tickets, and it will be Bob’s turn after 6 more
highlights.phrase_id: 8 orang sudah membeli tiket, dan giliran Bob tiba setelah 6 orang lagi
highlights.note_en: Everyone in front of Bob: 8 + 6 = 14.
highlights.note_id: Semua yang di depan Bob: 8 + 6 = 14.

strategy.name_en: Find Bob's position, then mirror it around the middle
strategy.name_id: Temukan posisi Bob, lalu cerminkan di sekitar tengah

trap.why_en: 14 + 14 = 28 forgets to count Bob himself.
trap.why_id: 14 + 14 = 28 lupa menghitung Bob sendiri.

questions.body_en: Look at the picture. Find the product of the number on the left of the apple and the number on the top right of the apple.
questions.body_id: Perhatikan gambar. Tentukan hasil kali bilangan di sebelah kiri apel dan bilangan di kanan atas apel.
hint_steps_en: The apple sits in the middle of the grid 1 9 4 / 7 🍎 6 / 5 8 2.
On the apple's LEFT is 7. On its TOP RIGHT (one up, one right) is 4.
hint_steps_id: Apel berada di tengah kotak 1 9 4 / 7 🍎 6 / 5 8 2.
Di KIRI apel ada 7. Di KANAN ATASNYA (satu naik, satu kanan) ada 4.

highlights.phrase_en: on the left of the apple
highlights.note_en: Straight to the left: the 7.
highlights.note_id: Tepat di kiri: angka 7.

highlights.phrase_en: on the top right of the apple
highlights.note_en: Diagonally up-right: the 4 — not the 9 above or the 6 beside!
highlights.note_id: Diagonal kanan-atas: angka 4 — bukan 9 di atas atau 6 di samping!

strategy.name_en: Read positions like a map before multiplying
strategy.name_id: Baca posisi seperti peta sebelum mengalikan

trap.why_en: Mixing up top-right with the 6 on the right gives 7 × 6 = 42.
trap.why_id: Tertukar antara kanan-atas dengan 6 di kanan memberi 7 × 6 = 42.

questions.body_en: There are two pillars, one thick and one thin. A rope goes around pillar A exactly 4 times; the same rope goes around pillar B 8 times (4 more times). If another rope goes around pillar B 10 times, how many times can it go around pillar A?
questions.body_id: Ada dua pilar, satu tebal dan satu tipis. Seutas tali melilit pilar A tepat 4 kali; tali yang sama melilit pilar B 8 kali (4 kali lebih banyak). Jika tali lain melilit pilar B 10 kali, berapa kali tali itu dapat melilit pilar A?
hint_steps_en: The first rope: 4 loops around A = 8 loops around B.
So one loop around A uses as much rope as 2 loops around B — A is twice as thick.
The second rope makes 10 loops around B → 10 ÷ 2 = 5 loops around A.
hint_steps_id: Tali pertama: 4 lilitan di A = 8 lilitan di B.
Jadi satu lilitan di A memakai tali sebanyak 2 lilitan di B — A dua kali lebih tebal.
Tali kedua melilit B 10 kali → 10 ÷ 2 = 5 lilitan di A.

highlights.phrase_en: around pillar A exactly 4 times; the same rope goes around pillar B 8 times
highlights.phrase_id: melilit pilar A tepat 4 kali; tali yang sama melilit pilar B 8 kali
highlights.note_en: Same rope, so 4 loops of A = 8 loops of B → 1 loop of A = 2 loops of B.
highlights.note_id: Tali sama, jadi 4 lilitan A = 8 lilitan B → 1 lilitan A = 2 lilitan B.

highlights.phrase_en: how many times can it go around pillar A
highlights.phrase_id: berapa kali tali itu dapat melilit pilar A
highlights.note_en: Convert B-loops into A-loops with the 2:1 rate.
highlights.note_id: Ubah lilitan B menjadi lilitan A dengan rasio 2:1.

quantities.value: 1 loop of A = 2 loops of B

strategy.name_en: Find the loop exchange rate from the first rope
strategy.name_id: Temukan nilai tukar lilitan dari tali pertama

trap.why_en: 10 − 4 = 6 reuses the “4 more” from the FIRST rope — but that 4 belongs to a different rope length.
trap.why_id: 10 − 4 = 6 memakai ulang “4 lebih banyak” dari tali PERTAMA — padahal itu milik panjang tali yang berbeda.

questions.body_en: Below are five denominations of United States currency: $100, $20, $10, $5, and $1, with a tally of how many bills of each kind there are. How many dollars are there in total?
questions.body_id: Berikut lima pecahan uang Amerika: $100, $20, $10, $5, dan $1, dengan turus banyaknya lembar tiap pecahan. Berapa dolar seluruhnya?
hint_steps_en: Big bills first: 400 + 120 = 520.
hint_steps_id: Pecahan besar dulu: 400 + 120 = 520.

highlights.phrase_en: with a tally of how many bills
highlights.note_en: A five-bar gate (㥕) counts 5 — read each tally carefully.
highlights.note_id: Turus bersilang dihitung 5 — baca tiap turus dengan teliti.

highlights.phrase_en: How many dollars are there in total?
highlights.note_en: Multiply each denomination by its count, then add.
highlights.note_id: Kalikan tiap pecahan dengan banyaknya, lalu jumlahkan.

strategy.name_en: Value × count per row, largest first
strategy.name_id: Nilai × banyak per baris, dari yang terbesar

trap.why_en: Reading the $20 tally as 5 instead of 6 (the crossed gate PLUS one stick) loses $20.
trap.why_id: Membaca turus $20 sebagai 5 alih-alih 6 (gerbang silang PLUS satu garis) kehilangan $20.

highlights.note_en: Undo the subtraction: 🐝 = 38 + 45.
highlights.note_id: Balikkan pengurangan: 🐝 = 38 + 45.

highlights.note_en: The missing subtrahend: 🦋 = 62 − 33.
highlights.note_id: Pengurang yang hilang: 🦋 = 62 − 33.

strategy.name_en: Solve each symbol first, then combine
strategy.name_id: Selesaikan tiap simbol dulu, lalu gabungkan

trap.why_en: Computing 🦋 as 62 − 33 = 29 but then slipping to 83 − 25 or similar — keep the two results straight before subtracting.
trap.why_id: 🦋 = 29 tapi kemudian keliru mengurangkan — pastikan kedua hasil benar sebelum dikurangkan.

questions.body_en: Count the letters in the words below. Which letter appears the most often? APPLE, PENCIL, ERASER, AIRPLANE, ELEPHANT, BANANA, PIG
questions.body_id: Hitung huruf dalam kata-kata berikut. Huruf mana yang paling sering muncul? APPLE, PENCIL, ERASER, AIRPLANE, ELEPHANT, BANANA, PIG
hint_steps_en: Tally each candidate letter word by word.
hint_steps_id: Turus tiap huruf kandidat kata demi kata.
A: 1+0+1+2+1+3+0 = 8 — paling banyak.

highlights.phrase_en: APPLE, PENCIL, ERASER, AIRPLANE, ELEPHANT, BANANA, PIG
highlights.phrase_id: APPLE, PENCIL, ERASER, AIRPLANE, ELEPHANT, BANANA, PIG
highlights.note_en: Seven words — tally one letter at a time across all of them.
highlights.note_id: Tujuh kata — turus satu huruf demi satu huruf di semuanya.

highlights.note_en: BANANA alone holds three A's — don't miss them.
highlights.note_id: BANANA saja memuat tiga huruf A — jangan terlewat.

strategy.name_en: Tally word by word, one candidate letter at a time
strategy.name_id: Turus kata demi kata, satu huruf kandidat tiap kali

trap.why_en: E leads early (APPLE, PENCIL, ERASER…) but BANANA's three A's flip the race: A 8, E 7.
trap.why_id: E unggul di awal (APPLE, PENCIL, ERASER…) tapi tiga A di BANANA membalik keadaan: A 8, E 7.

questions.body_en: How many figures below can be formed by two of the L-shaped pieces? (They can be rotated, but they cannot be flipped over.)
questions.body_id: Berapa banyak gambar di bawah yang dapat dibentuk oleh dua keping berbentuk L? (Boleh diputar, tidak boleh dibalik.)
hint_steps_en: The piece has 4 squares (a row of 3 plus 1 on the right end), so each figure needs exactly 2 pieces = 8 squares.
Try to split each figure into two L's using only rotations: figures 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 all split cleanly.
Figure 4 cannot: any L you place leaves behind a shape that is not an L (without flipping).
So 5 figures work.
hint_steps_id: Kepingnya 4 petak (deret 3 plus 1 di ujung kanan), jadi tiap gambar butuh tepat 2 keping = 8 petak.
Coba belah tiap gambar menjadi dua L hanya dengan rotasi: gambar 1, 2, 3, 5, dan 6 semua terbelah rapi.
Gambar 4 tidak bisa: L mana pun yang ditaruh menyisakan bentuk yang bukan L (tanpa membalik).
Jadi 5 gambar yang bisa.

highlights.note_en: Each piece covers 4 squares — figures must split into two L's.
highlights.note_id: Tiap keping menutup 4 petak — gambar harus terbelah menjadi dua L.

highlights.note_en: Only rotations — the mirror-image L is NOT allowed.
highlights.note_id: Hanya rotasi — L hasil cermin TIDAK boleh.

strategy.name_en: Place one L, check whether the leftover is also an L
strategy.name_id: Letakkan satu L, periksa apakah sisanya juga L

trap.why_en: Figure 4 LOOKS like the others but its corner cell strands a non-L leftover — and counting it out of caution gives only 4.
trap.why_id: Gambar 4 TAMPAK seperti yang lain tapi sel sudutnya menyisakan bentuk bukan-L — dan kehati-hatian berlebih memberi hanya 4.

questions.body_en: Below is the unfolded net of a box without a lid. The base is 2 cm by 2 cm and every wall is 2 cm tall. How many cubes with 1 cm sides can be put inside this box?
questions.body_id: Berikut jaring-jaring kotak tanpa tutup. Alasnya 2 cm kali 2 cm dan semua dindingnya setinggi 2 cm. Berapa kubus bersisi 1 cm yang dapat dimasukkan ke kotak ini?
hint_steps_en: The net folds into a box with a 2 × 2 base and height 2.
The bottom layer holds 2 × 2 = 4 cubes.
The walls are 2 cm tall, so a second layer fits: 4 + 4 = 8 cubes.
hint_steps_id: Jaring-jaring terlipat menjadi kotak dengan alas 2 × 2 dan tinggi 2.
Lapisan bawah memuat 2 × 2 = 4 kubus.
Dindingnya setinggi 2 cm, jadi lapisan kedua muat: 4 + 4 = 8 kubus.

highlights.phrase_en: The base is 2 cm by 2 cm
highlights.note_en: Each layer holds 2 × 2 = 4 cubes.
highlights.note_id: Tiap lapisan memuat 2 × 2 = 4 kubus.

highlights.note_en: Height 2 → two layers of cubes.
highlights.note_id: Tinggi 2 → dua lapisan kubus.

strategy.name_en: Fold the net in your head: base × height in layers
strategy.name_id: Lipat jaringnya dalam pikiran: alas × tinggi dalam lapisan

trap.why_en: Counting only the bottom layer (4) forgets the box is 2 cm deep.
trap.why_id: Hanya menghitung lapisan bawah (4) melupakan kedalaman kotak 2 cm.

hint_steps_en: Add the pluses step by step: 34 + 27 = 61, 61 + 16 = 77.
hint_steps_id: Jumlahkan langkah demi langkah: 34 + 27 = 61, 61 + 16 = 77.

highlights.note_en: Six numbers — keep a running total, one operation at a time.
highlights.note_id: Enam bilangan — jaga total berjalan, satu operasi tiap kali.

strategy.name_en: Running total, left to right
strategy.name_id: Total berjalan, kiri ke kanan

trap.why_en: Stopping before the final − 17.
trap.why_id: Berhenti sebelum − 17 terakhir.

questions.body_en: In the diagram each straight chain of circles counts up by the same step. The animals hide numbers: 18 → 20 → 🐤 → 24 across the top; 🐑 → 24 → 27 → 🐊 down the middle; 🐊 → 🦁 → 40 → 45 across the bottom. Find 🐑 + 🐤 + 🐊 + 🦁.
questions.body_id: Pada diagram, setiap rantai lurus lingkaran naik dengan langkah sama. Hewan-hewan menyembunyikan bilangan: 18 → 20 → 🐤 → 24 mendatar di atas; 🐑 → 24 → 27 → 🐊 menurun di tengah; 🐊 → 🦁 → 40 → 45 mendatar di bawah. Tentukan 🐑 + 🐤 + 🐊 + 🦁.
hint_steps_en: Top chain: 18, 20, 🐤, 24 steps by 2 → 🐤 = 22.
Middle chain: 🐑, 24, 27, 🐊 steps by 3 → 🐑 = 21 and 🐊 = 30.
Bottom chain: 30, 🦁, 40, 45 steps by 5 → 🦁 = 35.
hint_steps_id: Rantai atas: 18, 20, 🐤, 24 melangkah 2 → 🐤 = 22.
Rantai tengah: 🐑, 24, 27, 🐊 melangkah 3 → 🐑 = 21 dan 🐊 = 30.
Rantai bawah: 30, 🦁, 40, 45 melangkah 5 → 🦁 = 35.

highlights.phrase_en: counts up by the same step
highlights.note_en: Each chain has its OWN step — find it from two known neighbours.
highlights.note_id: Tiap rantai punya langkahnya SENDIRI — temukan dari dua tetangga yang diketahui.

highlights.note_en: Decode all four animals before adding.
highlights.note_id: Pecahkan keempat hewan sebelum menjumlah.

strategy.name_en: Read each chain's step from its known pair, then fill the rest
strategy.name_id: Baca langkah tiap rantai dari pasangan yang diketahui, lalu isi sisanya

trap.why_en: Assuming all chains step by 2 (like the top) gives the wrong sheep, crocodile and lion.
trap.why_id: Menganggap semua rantai melangkah 2 (seperti atas) membuat domba, buaya, dan singa salah.

questions.body_en: Look at the picture. At least how many more cubes are needed to form a complete cube?
questions.body_id: Perhatikan gambar. Paling sedikit berapa kubus lagi yang dibutuhkan untuk membentuk kubus yang utuh?
hint_steps_en: The complete shape is a 4 × 4 × 4 cube.
Count the missing cubes column by column in the carved pit: three columns miss 1, two columns miss 2, one column misses 3.
hint_steps_id: Bentuk utuhnya kubus 4 × 4 × 4.
Hitung kubus hilang kolom demi kolom pada cekungan: tiga kolom kurang 1, dua kolom kurang 2, satu kolom kurang 3.

highlights.note_en: Count the missing spaces, including the deeper levels.
highlights.note_id: Hitung ruang yang hilang, termasuk tingkat yang lebih dalam.

highlights.note_en: Every column must reach the full height of 4.
highlights.note_id: Setiap kolom harus mencapai tinggi penuh 4.

strategy.name_en: Count what each column still needs to reach height 4
strategy.name_id: Hitung kekurangan tiap kolom untuk mencapai tinggi 4

trap.why_en: Counting one gap per carved column misses that some columns are 2 or 3 cubes deep.
trap.why_id: Menghitung satu celah per kolom melewatkan kolom yang dalamnya 2 atau 3 kubus.

questions.body_en: Each hexagon is split into six parts around a center number. Observe the pattern and find 🍍. Hexagon 1: 2, 9, 3, 5, 1, 4 around 31. Hexagon 2: 8, 9, 4, 1, 2, 7 around 54. Hexagon 3: 4, 2, 8, 5, 6, 3 around 🍍.
questions.body_id: Setiap segi enam terbagi enam bagian mengelilingi bilangan tengah. Amati polanya dan tentukan 🍍. Segi enam 1: 2, 9, 3, 5, 1, 4 mengelilingi 31. Segi enam 2: 8, 9, 4, 1, 2, 7 mengelilingi 54. Segi enam 3: 4, 2, 8, 5, 6, 3 mengelilingi 🍍.
hint_steps_en: Pair each number with the one OPPOSITE it across the hexagon.
Hexagon 1: 2×5 + 9×1 + 4×3 = 10 + 9 + 12 = 31 ✓ — the center is the sum of the three opposite products.
hint_steps_id: Pasangkan tiap bilangan dengan yang BERSEBERANGAN pada segi enam.
Segi enam 1: 2×5 + 9×1 + 4×3 = 10 + 9 + 12 = 31 ✓ — tengah adalah jumlah tiga hasil kali pasangan seberang.

highlights.phrase_en: split into six parts around a center number
highlights.phrase_id: terbagi enam bagian mengelilingi bilangan tengah
highlights.note_en: Six outer numbers form three OPPOSITE pairs.
highlights.note_id: Enam bilangan luar membentuk tiga pasangan BERSEBERANGAN.

highlights.note_en: Find the rule on the two complete hexagons first.
highlights.note_id: Temukan aturannya pada dua segi enam lengkap dulu.

strategy.name_en: Multiply opposite pairs, then add the three products
strategy.name_id: Kalikan pasangan berseberangan, lalu jumlahkan ketiga hasil kalinya

trap.why_en: Adding all six outer numbers (4+2+8+5+6+3 = 28) ignores that the rule multiplies opposite pairs.
trap.why_id: Menjumlah keenam bilangan luar (4+2+8+5+6+3 = 28) mengabaikan aturan kali pasangan seberang.

questions.body_en: Put all 5 number cards 3, 5, 5, 8, 1 into the boxes to complete the number sentence □□ − □□ + □ = ?. If the smallest possible result is m, find m.
questions.body_id: Masukkan kelima kartu angka 3, 5, 5, 8, 1 ke dalam kotak untuk melengkapi kalimat bilangan □□ − □□ + □ = ?. Jika hasil terkecil yang mungkin adalah m, tentukan m.
hint_steps_en: To make the result small, make the two 2-digit numbers as CLOSE as possible.
With digits 3, 5, 5, 8, 1: try 51 − 53 = −2? Negative isn't allowed for the first pair — use 51 and 53 the other way: 53 − 51 = 2, leaving 8: 2 + 8 = 10. Can we do better?

Try 51 − 53 + 8: the subtraction must stay possible — 51 − 53 is negative, so instead try making the difference small with the +card small: 53 − 55? The two 5s can't both lead. Check 51 − 53 + 8 = 6 — allowed when working left to right with a temporary dip? The safe minimal arrangement is 51 − 53 + 8 = 6.
hint_steps_id: Agar hasil kecil, buat dua bilangan 2-angka SEDEKAT mungkin.
Dengan angka 3, 5, 5, 8, 1: selisih terkecil pasangan 2-angka adalah 51 dan 53.

highlights.note_en: All five cards must be used: two 2-digit numbers and one single digit.
highlights.note_id: Kelima kartu harus dipakai: dua bilangan 2-angka dan satu angka tunggal.

highlights.note_en: Make the subtraction nearly cancel, and add the leftover.
highlights.note_id: Buat pengurangan hampir saling menghapus, lalu tambah sisanya.

strategy.name_en: Minimize the difference of the two 2-digit numbers first
strategy.name_id: Minimalkan dulu selisih dua bilangan 2-angka

trap.why_en: 53 − 51 + 8 = 10 keeps the subtraction positive, but 51 − 53 + 8 = 6 is smaller and still a valid whole-number result.
trap.why_id: 53 − 51 + 8 = 10 menjaga pengurangan positif, tapi 51 − 53 + 8 = 6 lebih kecil dan tetap hasil bilangan bulat yang sah.

questions.body_en: Suppose an integer n makes the sum 1 + 2 + 3 + … + n a 2-digit number made up of the same digit. Find the sum of all possible n's.
questions.body_id: Misalkan bilangan bulat n membuat jumlah 1 + 2 + 3 + … + n menjadi bilangan 2-angka dengan kedua angkanya sama. Tentukan jumlah semua n yang mungkin.
hint_steps_en: The same-digit 2-digit numbers are 11, 22, 33, 44, 55, 66, 77, 88, 99.
Matches: 55 (n = 10) and 66 (n = 11).
Sum of the n's: 10 + 11 = 21.
hint_steps_id: Bilangan 2-angka berdigit sama: 11, 22, 33, 44, 55, 66, 77, 88, 99.
Yang cocok: 55 (n = 10) dan 66 (n = 11).
Jumlah n: 10 + 11 = 21.

highlights.phrase_en: a 2-digit number made up of the same digit
highlights.note_en: Only nine targets: 11, 22, …, 99.
highlights.note_id: Hanya sembilan sasaran: 11, 22, …, 99.

highlights.note_en: Add the n values, not the sums!
highlights.note_id: Jumlahkan nilai n, bukan jumlah deretnya!

strategy.name_en: List the triangular numbers and pick out the repdigits
strategy.name_id: Daftarkan bilangan segitiga dan pilih yang berdigit sama

trap.why_en: 55 + 66 = 121 adds the SUMS — the question asks for the sum of the n's: 10 + 11.
trap.why_id: 55 + 66 = 121 menjumlahkan HASILNYA — yang ditanya jumlah n: 10 + 11.

questions.body_en: Choose six different numbers from 1–9 to write on the six faces of a cube, one per face. Three faces already show 3, 7 and 8. If each pair of opposite faces has the same sum, find the product of the largest and smallest numbers that can sit opposite the 7.
questions.body_id: Pilih enam bilangan berbeda dari 1–9 untuk ditulis pada enam sisi kubus, satu per sisi. Tiga sisi sudah berisi 3, 7, dan 8. Jika setiap pasangan sisi berhadapan jumlahnya sama, tentukan hasil kali bilangan terbesar dan terkecil yang dapat berhadapan dengan 7.
hint_steps_en: Let the common pair-sum be S. The partners of 3, 8 and 7 are S−3, S−8 and S−7.
All must be between 1 and 9: S−8 ≥ 1 → S ≥ 9, and S−3 ≤ 9 → S ≤ 12.
S = 9: partners 6, 1, 2 ✓ (7's partner is 2). S = 10: partner of 3 would be 7 — already used ✗. S = 11: partner of 3 is 8 — used ✗. S = 12: partners 9, 4, 5 ✓ (7's partner is 5).
7's partner is 2 or 5 → product 2 × 5 = 10.
hint_steps_id: Misal jumlah pasangan S. Pasangan 3, 8, 7 adalah S−3, S−8, dan S−7.
Semua harus antara 1 dan 9: S−8 ≥ 1 → S ≥ 9, dan S−3 ≤ 9 → S ≤ 12.
S = 9: pasangan 6, 1, 2 ✓ (pasangan 7 adalah 2). S = 10: pasangan 3 adalah 7 — sudah dipakai ✗. S = 11: pasangan 3 adalah 8 — dipakai ✗. S = 12: pasangan 9, 4, 5 ✓ (pasangan 7 adalah 5).
Pasangan 7 adalah 2 atau 5 → hasil kali 2 × 5 = 10.

highlights.phrase_en: each pair of opposite faces has the same sum
highlights.phrase_id: setiap pasangan sisi berhadapan jumlahnya sama
highlights.note_en: One sum S rules all three pairs.
highlights.note_id: Satu jumlah S mengatur ketiga pasangan.

highlights.note_en: Partners must avoid 3, 7, 8 and stay within 1–9 — this kills S = 10 and 11.
highlights.note_id: Pasangan harus menghindari 3, 7, 8 dan tetap dalam 1–9 — ini menggugurkan S = 10 dan 11.

strategy.name_en: Try each possible pair-sum S and reject clashes
strategy.name_id: Coba tiap kemungkinan jumlah pasangan S dan buang yang bertabrakan

trap.why_en: 9 × 5 multiplies the largest PARTNERS overall — the question asks only about the faces opposite the 7.
trap.why_id: 9 × 5 mengalikan pasangan terbesar secara keseluruhan — yang ditanya hanya sisi yang berhadapan dengan 7.

questions.body_en: The tower in the picture is formed by rectangles that are 25 cm by 10 cm and squares that are 5 cm by 5 cm. How tall is the tower in cm?
questions.body_id: Menara pada gambar dibentuk oleh persegi panjang 25 cm kali 10 cm dan persegi 5 cm kali 5 cm. Berapa tinggi menara dalam cm?
hint_steps_en: Read the tower bottom to top, adding each layer's HEIGHT (a 25×10 rectangle adds 10 lying down or 25 standing up; a square adds 5).
Feet 10 + squares 10 + legs 25 + band 10 + band 10 = 65.
Torso 25 + band 10 + neck 25 = 60 more → 125.
Tip: three squares = 15. Total 125 + 15 = 140.
hint_steps_id: Baca menara dari bawah ke atas, menjumlah TINGGI tiap lapisan (persegi panjang 25×10 menambah 10 jika rebah atau 25 jika berdiri; persegi menambah 5).
Kaki 10 + persegi 10 + tungkai 25 + pita 10 + pita 10 = 65.
Badan 25 + pita 10 + leher 25 = tambah 60 → 125.
Puncak: tiga persegi = 15. Total 125 + 15 = 140.

highlights.phrase_en: rectangles that are 25 cm by 10 cm and squares that are 5 cm by 5 cm
highlights.phrase_id: persegi panjang 25 cm kali 10 cm dan persegi 5 cm kali 5 cm
highlights.note_en: A lying rectangle adds 10 to the height; a standing one adds 25; a square adds 5.
highlights.note_id: Persegi panjang rebah menambah 10 ke tinggi; yang berdiri menambah 25; persegi menambah 5.

highlights.note_en: Only the HEIGHTS stack — climb layer by layer.
highlights.note_id: Hanya TINGGI yang bertumpuk — naik lapis demi lapis.

strategy.name_en: Climb the tower, adding one layer's height per step
strategy.name_id: Naiki menara, tambahkan tinggi satu lapis tiap langkah

trap.why_en: Forgetting the little 5-cm squares at the tip (3 × 5 = 15) leaves the tower short.
trap.why_id: Melupakan persegi 5 cm di puncak (3 × 5 = 15) membuat menara kurang tinggi.

questions.body_en: A rabbit wants to eat the carrot. It must pass every square exactly once, but cannot enter squares with stones. Moves are written as numbers: 1 = up, 2 = left, 3 = down, 4 = right. Write the move numbers in order and find their sum.
questions.body_id: Seekor kelinci ingin makan wortel. Ia harus melewati setiap petak tepat satu kali, tetapi tidak boleh masuk petak berbatu. Gerakan ditulis sebagai angka: 1 = atas, 2 = kiri, 3 = bawah, 4 = kanan. Tuliskan angka gerakan berurutan dan tentukan jumlahnya.
hint_steps_en: The grid is 3 rows × 5 columns with stones blocking the top two cells of column 3; the rabbit starts bottom-left, the carrot is top-right.
The only route visiting all 13 open squares: up, up, right, down, down, right, right, right, up, left, up, right.
hint_steps_id: Kisinya 3 baris × 5 kolom dengan batu menutup dua sel atas kolom 3; kelinci mulai dari kiri bawah, wortel di kanan atas.
Satu-satunya rute yang melewati semua 13 petak terbuka: atas, atas, kanan, bawah, bawah, kanan, kanan, kanan, atas, kiri, atas, kanan.

highlights.phrase_id: melewati setiap petak tepat satu kali
highlights.note_en: Corners and the stone wall force the snake-like route.
highlights.note_id: Sudut dan dinding batu memaksa rute berkelok.

highlights.note_en: Sum the move NUMBERS, not the squares.
highlights.note_id: Jumlahkan ANGKA gerakan, bukan petaknya.

strategy.name_en: Let the stones and corners force the path, then add the move numbers
strategy.name_id: Biarkan batu dan sudut memaksa rute, lalu jumlahkan angka gerakannya

trap.why_en: Running straight to the carrot (4,4,4,4,1,1) skips most squares — every open square must be visited.
trap.why_id: Lari lurus ke wortel (4,4,4,4,1,1) melewatkan banyak petak — semua petak terbuka harus dilewati.

questions.body_en: The picture shows a 5×5 Sudoku with numbers 1–5. Small four-number clues printed where four squares meet mean those four squares must hold exactly those numbers. Find the 5-digit number ABCDE formed by the lettered column.
questions.body_id: Gambar menunjukkan Sudoku 5×5 dengan bilangan 1–5. Petunjuk empat-angka kecil yang dicetak di pertemuan empat petak berarti keempat petak itu harus berisi tepat bilangan-bilangan tersebut. Tentukan bilangan 5-angka ABCDE dari kolom berhuruf.
hint_steps_en: Givens: a 2 at row 3 column 3; clues 1235 (rows 1–2 × cols 3–4), 1335 (rows 2–3 × cols 1–2), 2355 (rows 2–3 × cols 2–3), 1345 (rows 3–4 × cols 1–2), 1234 (rows 4–5 × cols 2–3). A–E run down column 5.
The 2355 quad contains the given 2, so its other three cells hold 3, 5, 5 — and since 1335 shares two of those cells, the 5s and 3s interlock: row 2 starts 1 3 5 and row 3 starts 3 5 2.
Following the clues and the once-per-row-and-column rule fills the grid uniquely: rows are 24135, 13524, 35241, 41352, 52413.
Column 5 reads 5, 4, 1, 2, 3 top to bottom → ABCDE = 54123.
hint_steps_id: Yang diketahui: 2 di baris 3 kolom 3; petunjuk 1235 (baris 1–2 × kolom 3–4), 1335 (baris 2–3 × kolom 1–2), 2355 (baris 2–3 × kolom 2–3), 1345 (baris 3–4 × kolom 1–2), 1234 (baris 4–5 × kolom 2–3). A–E menuruni kolom 5.
Kuad 2355 memuat angka 2 yang diketahui, jadi tiga sel lainnya berisi 3, 5, 5 — dan karena 1335 berbagi dua sel itu, posisi 5 dan 3 saling mengunci: baris 2 dimulai 1 3 5 dan baris 3 dimulai 3 5 2.
Mengikuti petunjuk dan aturan sekali-per-baris-dan-kolom mengisi kisi secara unik: barisnya 24135, 13524, 35241, 41352, 52413.
Kolom 5 terbaca 5, 4, 1, 2, 3 dari atas ke bawah → ABCDE = 54123.

highlights.phrase_en: Small four-number clues printed where four squares meet
highlights.phrase_id: Petunjuk empat-angka kecil yang dicetak di pertemuan empat petak
highlights.note_en: A quad clue lists the multiset of its four cells — repeats matter (1335 has two 3s).
highlights.note_id: Petunjuk kuad mendaftar isi keempat selnya — pengulangan penting (1335 punya dua 3).

highlights.phrase_en: ABCDE formed by the lettered column
highlights.note_en: The letters run down column 5 — solve the grid first.
highlights.note_id: Huruf menuruni kolom 5 — selesaikan kisinya dulu.

strategy.name_en: Anchor on the quad that contains the given digit, then interlock the others
strategy.name_id: Berpijak pada kuad yang memuat angka yang diketahui, lalu kunci kuad lainnya

trap.why_en: Guessing the lettered column counts down — only the full Sudoku solve gives 5, 4, 1, 2, 3.
trap.why_id: Menebak kolom berhuruf menurun — hanya penyelesaian Sudoku penuh yang memberi 5, 4, 1, 2, 3.
